subject.title: Add DI composition root and navigation/activation seam for tray view models

question: Should the tray adopt these DI, navigation-scope, and dispatcher ownership seams now, before the first page is migrated to use them?
rationale: The patch is additive and currently runtime-no-op for page view models, but it intentionally establishes repository-wide architectural owners and shutdown/navigation lifecycle policy that should be explicitly sponsored by a maintainer.

options.title: Accept the foundation
options.body: Merge the additive seam now and require later page-migration PRs to use the established composition-root and NavigationScopeManager ownership boundaries.

options.title: Defer until first migration
options.body: Hold this PR and require the first real page view-model conversion to propose the seam together with its concrete consumer and runtime proof.

recommendation.title: Accept the foundation
recommendation.body: Merge the additive seam now and require later page-migration PRs to use the established composition-root and NavigationScopeManager ownership boundaries.

likelyOwner.reason: The recorded lifecycle review defines the relevant merge invariants and is the strongest available maintainer-routing signal.
